description: Ham radio digital modes and broadcast decoders: fldigi, WSJT-X, Direwolf, JS8Call, M17, HD Radio (nrsc5), and DAB/DAB+ (qt-dab).
notes:
Digital mode applications for amateur radio and broadcast reception. Includes GNU Radio 3.10 + OOT modules in the base.

For USB SDR device access, the container runs privileged.
